utility.description: Deterministic validation of agent computational artifacts against independently calculated baseline.

security.description: Pre-execution hooks and microVM boundary containment stopping adversarial exfiltration, destructive commands, and malicious packages.

reliability.description: Repeatable evaluation across independent fresh sandboxes calculating success rate, median/p90 wall-clock time, boot-to-ready time, and cost.

recovery.description: Lifecycle recovery policy applied to step-7-of-10 simulated crash with timestamped event audit trail.

known_limitations: MicroVM execution evaluated on Windows using Celesto Cloud protocol; local KVM/QEMU requires Linux/macOS host.
blocked_or_unverified_checks: Live Celesto Cloud Provisioning: Requires active paid subscription or trial activation credit (HTTP 402 observed).
